reason: The Facebook ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration.Configure method is now 'async void' with an awaited settings call, meaning the ResourceManifest may not be populated before ResourceManagementOptions is consumed, risking missing/broken 'fb' script resources on sites using the Facebook module, on top of core ResourceManager.cs dependency-resolution changes that affect resource rendering behavior
